premises.text: Enterprise rapid prototyping is slowed by fragmented machine software, operators, and file-exchange workflows
premises.evidence_span: they go back and forth with Excel files, spreadsheets, file shares. It's a very cumbersome process

premises.text: Manufacturing is decentralizing across multiple factories and locations
premises.evidence_span: manufacturing is decentralizing. Now you don't have engineers in one location. You have multiple factories and engineers in different locations

premises.text: A cloud manufacturing platform connects machines and workflows for one-click manufacturing anytime, anywhere
premises.evidence_span: connecting all these machines and workflows in the cloud, anytime, anywhere

premises.text: Designers can render designs for many machines in the cloud and remotely take over ready machines without local USB/SD workflows
premises.evidence_span: instead of having to deal with all the different software, I can instantly click on the different manufacturers for many, many different machines and instantly render it

premises.text: The platform also controls assembly workflows and can duplicate factories across sites
premises.evidence_span: It's also controlling the workflow, the assembly

value.text: Go from design to a real manufactured object instantly, anytime, anywhere
